description: Test the friend deletion safety mechanism in Flight Crew View. First, add a new friend named 'Safeguard Pilot' (use any airline/base). Once added, trigger the removal process for this friend (via long-press, swipe, or profile menu) to bring up the confirmation dialog. Finally, tap 'Cancel' (or 'No') in the dialog to abort the deletion. Verify that 'Safeguard Pilot' remains in your friends list.
